title: Skechers Men's Slip-ins John Deere Respected - Swamper Waterproof Boots (Open Box)
writeup: Woot has open-box Skechers x John Deere Respected - Swamper slip-in boots (style 256026) for $34.91. They're waterproof, relaxed-fit duck boots with Skechers' hands-free Slip-ins heel. Dunham's Sports lists the same boot at $84 and Skechers' own site sells it for $120, so this is about 58% below the lowest verified price. Woot showed only one pair left (limit 2 per customer), and the size wasn't visible on the listing, so check it before you buy.
